records.title: Multiplying and dividing fractions, Spine3.9
records.adopted: Use a consistent whole and partitioned-area/scaling meaning; compare two representations rather than assume a grid is self-explanatory.
records.rejected: Area model alone should not imply every multiplication makes numbers smaller or cover improper factors without explanation.
records.usageRestrictions: Conceptual comparison; original diagrams/text, no PD pack figures or passages reproduced.
records.limitations: Foreign pedagogical guidance, not empirical evidence for this Finnish lesson or an OPH mandate.

records.title: Year7 multiplying fractions, area model
records.adopted: Equal cells of one unit whole justify numerator and denominator products and equivalent simplified value.
records.rejected: Do not silently switch which whole is being measured; no requirement to simplify for credit when value is equal.
records.usageRestrictions: Mathematical fact/design comparison only; own graphics/text, no protected figures copied.
records.limitations: Comparable Year7 conceptual source; project examples/control flow not efficacy-validated.

records.title: Prealgebra2e4.2 — multiplication and equivalent fractions
records.adopted: Equivalent reduced/unreduced fractions preserve value; improper factor results must not be excluded.
records.rejected: Reciprocal/division and symbolic-variable drills outside this learning boundary.
records.usageRestrictions: Current page states noncommercial sharealike terms for reproduced content; no protected prose/figures/exercises reproduced, mathematical facts independently derived. No blanket CC-BY attribution asserted.
records.limitations: Reference corroboration, not permission to copy or proof of classroom effectiveness.

alignment.inherited: Part of a part; area partitions, factor multiplication and half-quantity transfer, equal fraction forms.
alignment.corrected: Actual whole explicit, no denominator addition or universal multiplication-makes-bigger claim. Unreduced/equivalent decimals accepted exactly. Proper-only diagram contract rejects improper/invalid parameters; general arithmetic handles improper factors.
alignment.extended: Original controllable area phases, zero/one and improper arithmetic boundaries, transfer to length; no required verbalization or enforced model click path.

planning.childGoal: Ymmärrän, miten osa osasta lasketaan kertomalla.
planning.assumptions: Frozen FRAC15/FRAC03 required; simplification explained as same-value relation, not new hard gate. Signed arithmetic possible in pure truth but negative sign rules not taught or assumed in required UI.
planning.scope: Multiply fractions, positive/zero proper part-area and improper arithmetic examples; no fraction division or reciprocal curriculum. Same unit whole fixed in area, length transfer explicitly metre whole.
planning.evidenceLimits: Guided model and low-stakes fresh products; support/feedback allowed, not independent retained mastery or formal learner evidence. No personal history.
planning.sourceVsDesign: Frozen graph provenance inherited; no new OPH requirement or efficacy claim. Story, examples, exact model bounds, controls and pedagogical sequencing are project design.
planning.assetProvenance: Original deterministic SVG. User-supplied actual transparent Aava/Loikka PNG unchanged, named in lesson, no substitute character artwork or decorative motion.

extensions.executionLimits: Four finite proper-fraction diagram descriptors, phase0..3, integer grid denominators1..8. Invalid/improper diagram factors explicitly rejected. General integer fraction truth absnumerators<=1000/denominators1..1000; typed answer <=4integer digits and3decimal digits, exact rational equality. Optional phaseplay1200ms, no physical-time semantics/autoplay, pause/reset/dispose stop. Active instance owned per resolved lesson root; previous mount disposed. Current visible enum controls validated, input/change handled and check re-reads current premise; blank/unsupported does not silently become zero. New mount actively enables its own controls after previous instance disposal; synthetic and native regression retains original disabled-remount failure. Plain decimal digit bounds apply after harmless leading/trailing-zero normalization (raw input max128characters); fraction answers normalize by exact gcd so equivalent unreduced forms within raw bound remain accepted. No rounding or scientific/expression eval. Static initial.svg derives from the same exact initial model state as mount; solved originalSVG retained separately in explanation. No-JavaScript fallback and live initial readout stay compatible.
